release_gates.evidence_needed: Signed-in named Inspire3 approval and affiliate agreement
Approved swipe/asset permissions or use all-original
Authenticated live SKU, source rights, checkout and delivery
Signed-out merchant checkout, order terms, refund processing
Both A+B show natively disabled controls; actual browser QA pending
Exact proximate text; activated links prohibited
Original 30–45s captioned MP4, opt-in play only
Native browser CWV/Lighthouse and low bytes
Actual immutable media URLs/asset IDs and rights
Existing consent-compliant events, no duplicate scripts
7/30 day qualified-human denominator and settled payments minus fees/refunds

verification_method: Official seller descriptions and regulator pages inspected Nov 7; no authenticated partner or buyer checkout. Scientific claims bounded to inspected primary abstracts and PLOS article.
pricing_note: Any seller-site prices are observations only; no fixed checkout price, payout or guarantee represented as fulfilled.
